scores.notes: Peter stepping from the boat (left) and in the courtyard foreground (right) both have dark curly hair greying at the temples, a short grey-flecked beard, tanned middle-aged face and stocky build.
Daniel being hauled from the den (left) and pointing before the king (right) is the same lean older man with short cropped grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin, in the same blue fringed robe.
Holmes in the train carriage (left) and striking at the bell-rope (right) has the same gaunt clean-shaven face, hawk nose, high forehead and slicked-back dark hair.

Left Holmes (dark-coated man pulling Watson through the door) is a youthful man with a tousled wavy dark fringe and soft face; right Holmes in the armchair is a gaunt, older, hawk-nosed man with slicked-back receding hair.
Peter diving from the boat (left, face small and tilted down) and in the courtyard (right) both show dark curly hair, a short dark beard, tanned skin and a stocky build; no cue conflicts.
Moses striking the rock (left) and seated with arms held up (right) is the same old man with swept-back white hair, full white beard and tanned lined face.

Peter at the bow with net and staff (left) and at the front of the group by the fire (right) both have dark curly hair touched with grey, a short greying dark beard and tan skin, with the same net over the shoulder.
Peter raising the lame man (left) and stepping from the boat (right) both have dark curly hair greying at the sides, a short grey-flecked beard, tan skin and sturdy build.
Daniel among the lions (left) and climbing out of the den (right) is the same lean older man with cropped grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin, wearing the same blue fringed robe and satchel.

Left Watson (arms folded) is a burly, broad-jawed, ruddy man with a heavy walrus moustache; right Watson in the carriage is a slim, narrow-faced man with a smaller moustache, so build and face shape conflict despite similar brown hair.

Both show a dry hillside with olive trees, low stone walls and flat-roofed stone houses above a lake with moored boats on the right and a white building on the slope; the white building is colonnaded on the left and domed on the right, but the layout is compatible.
David kneeling at the brook (left) and kneeling to be anointed (right) is the same slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and fair skin; the right face is bowed but nothing conflicts.
Holmes in the armchair (left) and raising the cane (right) share the gaunt hollow-cheeked clean-shaven face, hawk nose and slicked-back dark hair.

Left den is an enclosed bottle-shaped vault whose walls curve in to a small opening with a barred grate; right den is a broad open-topped straight cylinder with a wide mouth and wooden lid, so the pit's architecture conflicts despite the same stone blocks.
Holmes with the magnifying glass (left) and striking the bell-rope (right) both have the gaunt clean-shaven face, hawk nose, high forehead and swept-back dark hair.

Both have a long tea table under a big oak, but the house behind is a grey stone slate-roofed house on the left and a red-brick, half-timbered tiled cottage with a gabled porch on the right, and the table has a white cloth on the left and bare boards on the right.

Both show a single-masted open wooden fishing boat with a lantern on a dark storm-tossed sea under a moon breaking through clouds, with a dark headland on the horizon; extra boats and lightning on the left are compatible.
Daniel pointing before the king (left) and standing in the pit (right, small) both have cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, tan skin and lean build in a dark blue fringed robe.
Jesus calling at the tomb (left) and standing in the boat (right) has the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, short dark beard, slim build and white tunic with blue mantle.

Peter clasping the lame man's hand (left) and standing centre on the shore (right) both have dark curly hair, a short dark beard greying at the chin, tan skin and sturdy build, with net and staff in both.
Holmes with pipe and photograph (left) and holding the magnifying glass (right) share the gaunt clean-shaven profile, hawk nose and slicked-back dark hair.

Moses seated with arms held up (left) and raising the rod at the rock (right) is the same aged man with white hair, full white beard and tanned face; hair is a little longer on the right but nothing conflicts.

Alice by the mushroom (left, small, in profile) and holding the bottle (right) is the same young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and slight build, in the same yellow dress and striped stockings.
Moses seated with arms supported (left) and holding the staff toward the sea (right, in profile from behind) both show long white hair, a full white beard and an aged tanned face.
Moses stretching his hand over the sea (left) and walking at the right front of the column (right) is the same old man with windswept white hair, long white beard and brown cloak over a pale tunic.
Watson holding the hat (left) and in a bowler in the carriage (right) both have brown hair, a thick brown moustache, a ruddy squarish face and solid build of similar middle age.
Holmes stooping on the pavement (left) and holding the magnifying glass (right) share the gaunt clean-shaven face, hawk nose, high forehead and slicked-back dark hair.
Watson in a bowler in the carriage (left) and seated by the fire (right) both have brown hair, a full brown moustache, ruddy squarish face and solid middle-aged build.
Peter stepping from the boat (left) and pulling the lame man up (right) both have dark curly hair, a short grey-streaked beard, weathered tan face and sturdy build.

David dodging the spear (left) and kneeling at the brook (right) is a slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and fair ruddy skin in both; he looks slightly younger on the left but no cue conflicts.
Daniel watching the vision (left) and standing in the pit (right, small) both have cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, tan skin and lean build in the same dark blue fringed robe.
Holmes with the pipe outside the shop (left, small) and raising the cane (right) both show a tall thin clean-shaven man with gaunt face and slicked-back dark hair.

Peter with hand on chest in the courtyard (left) and leaping from the boat (right) both have short curly hair, a short greying beard, tan skin and sturdy build; hair reads greyer on the right but both are greying, so no clear conflict.
Watson in a bowler on the pavement (left) and seated on the bed (right) both have a brown moustache, ruddy squarish face and solid build of similar age; hair is hidden by the hat on the left.
Daniel climbing out of the den (left) and addressing the king (right) is the same lean older man with cropped grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin, in the same blue fringed robe with satchel.
Holmes stooping on the pavement (left) and reaching with the cane by matchlight (right) share the gaunt clean-shaven face, hawk nose, high forehead and slicked-back dark hair.
Moses with staff before the parted sea (left, in profile from behind) and seated with arms held up (right) both have white hair, a full white beard and aged tanned face.

Holmes in the armchair with a pipe (left) and stooping in a hat on the pavement (right, small) both show a thin clean-shaven man with a gaunt hawk-nosed face; the hat hides the hair on the right but nothing conflicts.

David slinging (left, small) and kneeling to be anointed (right, head bowed) both show a slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and light tan skin in a brown tunic; faces are small but no cue conflicts.

Both show a long cloth-covered tea table with wooden chairs on a lawn under a large spreading oak, with a pale stone country house behind on the left side; the house has more gables on the left but the kind and arrangement of place agree.
David kneeling to be anointed (left, head bowed) and dodging the spear (right) is the same slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and fair ruddy skin in a brown tunic with shoulder bag.

Alice by the mushroom (left, small, in profile) and holding the flamingo (right) is the same young girl with long light-brown hair and a headband, fair skin and slight build, in the same yellow dress and striped stockings.

Peter gripping the lame man's hand (left) and front of the group at the fire (right) both have short curly hair, a short greying beard, tan weathered face and stocky build with a net on the shoulder; hair is greyer on the left but both are dark going grey.

Alice in the wing chair (left) and holding the flamingo (right) is the same young fair-skinned girl with long straight light-brown hair and round face, in the same yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings.

Both show a wet sandy, rock-strewn seabed corridor between heaped green waves under a dark storm sky with a rock outcrop where Moses stands; the walls are higher on the left, which fits the later moment, and the right adds shoreline cliffs seen from the bank.

Both have a cloth-covered table under a big oak, but the house is a stone cottage with a grey shingle roof, dormers and brick chimney on the left and a thatched, half-timbered cottage smothered in climbing roses on the right.

Moses raising the rod at the rock (left) and facing the parted sea (right, in profile from behind) both have long white hair, a full white beard and aged tanned face with the same dark cloak over a pale tunic.

Jesus calling at the tomb (left) and on the cross at upper right (right, small, head bowed) both show a slim man with shoulder-length dark hair, a short dark beard and light tan skin; the right face is small but no cue conflicts.

Jesus on the centre cross (left, small) and walking on the water (right) both show a slim man with shoulder-length dark brown hair, short dark beard and light tan skin; the left face is small but nothing conflicts.
Jesus on the water (left) and calling Lazarus out (right) has the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, short dark beard, slim build and white tunic with blue mantle.

Moses stretching his hand over the sea (left) and standing with staff beside the priest (right) is the same old man with white hair, a full white beard and tanned face in a dark cloak over a pale tunic.
Holmes pulling Watson into the room (left) and striking at the bell-rope (right) both have the tall thin frame, gaunt clean-shaven hawk-nosed face and slicked-back dark hair.

Peter standing at the front left of the courtyard (left) and at the bow of the boat (right) both have short dark hair going grey, a short grey-flecked dark beard, tan skin and sturdy build with a net on the shoulder.

Peter standing in the courtyard (left) and gripping the lame man's hand (right) both have a short greying beard, tan weathered face, strong brow and stocky build with a net on the shoulder; hair is curlier and greyer on the right but both read as dark going grey.
David after the sling throw (left) and kneeling at the brook (right) is the same slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and fair skin in a brown tunic with shoulder bag.

Both show a single-masted open wooden boat with a torn pale sail on a grey-green choppy sea under heavy storm clouds, with a hilly green shoreline on the horizon; the far boats on the left are compatible.

Both show a calm lake edge with a pebbly shore, a small charcoal fire by the water, a fishing boat with a net of fish just offshore and hazy hills with cypress and stone buildings across the water in daylight; the stone hut by the fire on the right could sit outside the left view.
Holmes pulling Watson in at the door (left) and holding the magnifying glass (right) share the gaunt clean-shaven hawk-nosed face, high forehead and slicked-back dark hair.

Watson at the door with bag and bowler (left, smaller) and seated by the fire (right) both have side-parted brown hair, a brown moustache, ruddy face and solid middle-aged build; the face looks a little squarer on the right but no clear cue conflicts.
